library.title: Fire / Civil Defense approval slip
library.risk: Opening date moves with the last FLS/CD approval.
library.root_cause: C&E matrix gaps: unit tests pass, integrated interface (detection→dampers→pressurisation→lifts→door release→BMS) fails. Disputed attribution extends delay.
library.mitigation: Early C&E/FLS review from concept through shop drawings. Do not infer occupancy from unit tests.
library.timing: Start prerequisite IDs ≥ T-2; compressed T-1 is high risk. Fire/CD paces occupancy cert.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: Systems go-live compressed below T-3
library.risk: PMS/POS/PABX/network/BMS cutover fails or is unstable for first guests.
library.root_cause: Server room not handed over (needs T-3 to T-6). Compressed T-1 floor is high risk.
library.mitigation: Hold go-live until server-room handover; dual-path network and BMS point list from M07.
library.timing: Safe LRM T-3 months; never treat T-1 as equivalent.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: OS&E order / fit-function failure
library.risk: Par stock late or delivered but unusable (clock, no socket).
library.root_cause: BOQ not frozen; operator not engaged; long-lead items unflagged; samples unapproved. Vendor lead 12–18 weeks.
library.mitigation: Order at T-6; short-lead only if compressed to T-3. Walk install points before accepting deliveries.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: Mass recruitment / key-hire split
library.risk: Commissioning inheritance and snag discovery have no owner; GM arrives too late to shape the opening.
library.root_cause: Treating recruitment as one date. GM needs ~T-12; Engineering and Housekeeping heads need min T-3; mass hiring is T-3–6.
library.mitigation: Split the plan: GM early; Eng/HK early; mass hire in the T-3–6 window. Sister-property task force is fallback only.
library.timing: GM T-12; Eng/HK min T-3; mass T-3–6.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: Licence chain started as a date, not a dependency
library.risk: Occupancy cert missing because prerequisite IDs were never collected.
library.root_cause: Licence submission is a chain, not a calendar. Fire/CD is the computed pacer.
library.mitigation: Start prerequisite identification ≥ T-2. Track CCTV/MOI, utilities, star classification as commonly missed rows.
library.timing: T-2 start; T-1 compressed = high risk.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: Unassigned operational items (FF&E/OS&E contest)
library.risk: IPTV/displays and desk power have no budget owner at opening.
library.root_cause: Approvers are distributed (designer → optional operator → owner budget) while procurement is centralized Owner-via-agent. The fight is not FF&E vs OS&E labels — it is unassigned operational items.
library.mitigation: Checkpoint: assign IPTV/displays and desk power before FF&E freeze. Record owner + budget code.
library.timing: At design freeze / FF&E spec lock (M02) and again at OS&E order (M09).
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: Delayed T&C forces acceptance (Category C)
library.risk: Operator accepts a live building with an open commissioning list.
library.root_cause: Testing and commissioning slip; commercial pressure to take keys.
library.mitigation: Independent Cx authority; refuse occupancy inference until integrated C&E is witnessed.
library.timing: During M07; do not wait for M14.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: GRMS certificate ≠ live configuration
library.risk: Room-by-room scale: certificate describes a map that is not loaded.
library.root_cause: Head-end accepted on paper; controllers unmapped or remapped after cert.
library.mitigation: Compare cert room list to live controller map. Incomplete map is UNPROVABLE, not a pass.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: Fire pump test-line-to-tank (invalid flow cert)
library.risk: Civil Defense pack cites a flow test that never left the tank loop.
library.root_cause: Test line discharged to tank; duty point / city connection unproven.
library.mitigation: Witness a test that proves flow to the system, not recirculation to tank. Covers/clips off; nameplate readable.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: Covers, clips, and incomplete labelling left on
library.risk: Nameplates and valve IDs cannot be matched to the register.
library.root_cause: Protective covers/clips never removed after install; labelling incomplete.
library.mitigation: Handover walk: covers/clips removed, labels present, serials photographed unobstructed.
library.timing: At MEP second-fix / Cx start and again at CD pack.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: Legionella / odour / water near opening
library.risk: Health authority or guest complaint in the first weeks.
library.root_cause: Domestic water stagnant through delayed opening; kitchen/guest odour transfer untested.
library.mitigation: Water-hygiene sample before soft opening; flush and disinfectant per named SOP — do not invent a frequency.
library.timing: In the T-1 window before first paying guest.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: CCTV signal loss and ICT licence gaps
library.risk: Police/MOI CCTV or ICT licence is the missed prerequisite; occupancy stalls.
library.root_cause: Post-commission CCTV signal loss; ICT licences expired or never applied. Commonly missed with star classification.
library.mitigation: Treat CCTV/MOI and ICT licence as first-class prerequisites. Re-verify signal after Cx, not only at FAT.
library.timing: Parallel with fire/CD; do not leave to T-1.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: Reduced battery life on ACS / locks
library.risk: Guest-room locks and access control fail in the opening month.
library.root_cause: Batteries aged through a long construction/Cx period; no spares at handover.
library.mitigation: Require new batteries plus a spare kit at handover. Do not inherit construction-era cells.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: Snags continue post-opening (Category C)
library.risk: Rooms and plant stay on a live snag list after first guests.
library.mitigation: Cap occupancy; publish a dated snag freeze; do not call Category C items 'closed'.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.

library.title: Post-opening contractual drag (Category D)
library.risk: DLP-deferred defects, out-of-scope testing disputes, late attic stock/spares.
library.root_cause: Commercial positions left open at grand opening.
library.mitigation: Register DLP items, testing-scope disputes, and attic-stock gaps as Category D — do not hide them inside 'opening complete'.
library.caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B (expert recall). Not Class A. Promote only with owner-uploaded artefacts.
